name: ^sender\.(urgent|ready)\.values\(\)\.next$
reason: Set iterator of the platform; the twin takes the first lane it yields and checks which set it asked.

name: ^sender\.idle\.resolve$
reason: Resolver from Promise.withResolvers; it takes no value and the twin checks when it is called.

name: ^write\.send$
reason: Port: the send function the caller handed to queueMirrorWrite; the twin takes its answer as input.
